svg.title: Sandbox defense in depth
svg.desc: An untrusted process is constrained by dropped privilege, namespace views, resource cgroups, syscall filtering, object policy and memory protection before reaching the shared kernel.
svg.text: A sandbox is a composition of restrictions with one shared-kernel boundary
cgroup v2: CPU, memory, PIDs and I/O governance
LSM / Landlock: object and operation policy
filter syscall number, architecture and scalar arguments
Memory W^X / ASLR and language/runtime defenses operate within the process boundary.
Shared host kernel remains in the TCB: a reachable kernel vulnerability or dangerous delegated device can cross all inner layers.
Fail closed, make setup irreversible before parsing untrusted input, and test the effective composed policy rather than each mechanism in isolation.
